business_problem: Orange wanted to become an omnichannel retailer with a broader product catalog and competitive prices, but needed market intelligence and dynamic pricing capabilities connected to its e-commerce marketplace.
solution_summary: Orange and Capgemini developed a digital marketplace and integrated a pricing ecosystem to support Orange's move from a traditional telecommunications catalog toward broader retail. The partners assessed market tools and selected Minderest and Reactev; Reactev's AI uses demand models and competitive information to recommend sale prices aligned with business objectives. Orange also developed a custom tool to monitor product costs and margins. The marketplace, pricing tool, and cost-management tool were connected so information could be centralized and price values updated in real time. The solution uses market and product information to improve pricing decisions and expand assortment, while the source does not identify the underlying AI model, detailed data platform, or hosting services.
products_used: Custom product cost and margin management tool

solution_components.role: Provides market and competitor information used in Orange's pricing strategy.

solution_components.name: Reactev
solution_components.role: Uses AI and demand models to recommend sale prices against business objectives.

solution_components.name: Orange digital marketplace
solution_components.role: Presents the expanded product catalog and customer-facing e-commerce offers.

solution_components.name: Custom product cost and margin management tool
solution_components.role: Tracks product-level costs and margins to inform pricing decisions.

data_flow: Market, product, cost, and margin information feeds the integrated Minderest, Reactev, and custom management tools; Reactev recommends prices, which are updated through the marketplace in real time.
business_outcome: The marketplace and AI-supported pricing improved Orange's digital-channel competitiveness and expanded the online catalog. The page reports more than 1,200 additional products, three times as many product categories, and increased sales through the digital channel.
